title: Where the band sat; piano or banjo in minstrel shows
summary: The band sat on a platform before the stage, with a piano if there was a girl singer.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Where was the band placed on the stage, or in an area, in relation to the minstrel performers?

Well, the minstrel performers... We had a stage. And the band would be right in front of the stage, down on the floor. They had a platform on there, but not as high as the stage -- a platform for the band. Sometimes they'd have a piano, and sometimes they just used a banjo in place of the piano. But mostly they used a piano, because they had a lot...they had a girl singer. A girl singer, you know, she had to sing behind the piano. I didn't know anything about singing then. I used to listen to the way other people would sing, you know.
